About PremiumCMS

PremiumCMS is a hosted platform built on EmDash, the Astro-native CMS, and Cloudflare's edge. We run one thing well: giving each customer a fully isolated site — worker, database, storage, domain and email of its own — with themes that are complete products rather than starting points.

Principles

Isolation. Your data lives in your own database and bucket. Deleting your site deletes everything, instantly and for good.

Honest pricing. Usage is metered at our cost times a published markup; every unit is itemised in your admin. Credits never turn into a bill.

Content as code. Themes carry their seed (pages, sections, settings) as files, so a site can be rebuilt from its repository and updated with one click.

Open. Themes and plugins are open source; you can fork the frontend to GitHub Pages at any time.

Contact

Email hello@premium-cms.com. For anything about your account or billing, sign in and use your dashboard.
